Trae Young is back with another episode of "From the Point," recorded live at NBA All-Star Weekend 2025 in San Francisco!

Joined by co-host Master Tesfatsion, Trae reveals how he found out that he initially did not make this year's All-Star team, what he thought, and what it meant for Quin Snyder to have his back. Then, he shares the surprising place he was in when he got the call that he was being added to the All-Star roster, and his reaction to that news. Plus, he talks about this year's Atlanta Hawks team, shouts out some other guys that could have made All-Star and more.
